evals.prompt: I just finished writing some CSS for a new component. Can you check if I'm using the design tokens properly? The file is shared/components.css
evals.expected_output: Should run the audit script scoped to that file (--file shared/components.css), identify hardcoded values that should use tokens, and suggest specific var() replacements

evals.prompt: Are there any tokens in tokens.css that we're not actually using anywhere? I want to clean up the token file.
evals.expected_output: Should run the unused tokens check and report which tokens are defined but never referenced

evals.prompt: I just added some inline styles to a React page in web/src. Did I hardcode anything I should have tokenized?
evals.expected_output: Should grep web/src for hardcoded hex/rgb/px inside style={{ }} (the script does not read .tsx), report each hit, and suggest the matching var(--token) replacement
